title: Which Beaches Do You Pass on a Boat Trip West of Funchal?
description: West of Funchal a boat passes Praia Formosa, Vigário, the shore under Cabo Girão, Fajã dos Padres, Calhau da Lapa and Ribeira Brava. All pebble or black sand.
heroAlt: The small pebble cove of Praia do Gorgulho below the Lido hotel cliffs, seen from the sea
keywords: which beaches do you pass on a boat trip west of Funchal

images.prompt: Mid-morning in early summer, photographed from the water about 150 metres off the Lido area of Funchal, Madeira. A small cove of dark grey pebbles sits at the foot of brown volcanic cliffs topped by white hotel buildings and terraces with palm trees. Two or three small swimmers seen from behind enter the water from the stones, gentle waves wash the shore, deep blue-green water in the foreground. Sun from behind the camera, true colours, no readable signs, no text.
images.alt: The small pebble cove of Praia do Gorgulho below the Lido hotel cliffs, seen from the sea
